dated_sections.description: Bound with January 28 letter, assigned January 15 by editor from confinement and travel. Preserve association and reasoning, without treating binding date or editorial assignment as independent exact completion proof.

within_day_events.description: Main text precedes reopening to acknowledge a newly arrived Fitch letter in P4; this new letter must not automatically condition P1–3.

evidence.quote: I have opened this note to thank you very sincerely for your renewed proof of your kindness in your letter just received

receipt_events.object: Latest Fitch specimens and two new Morris species
receipt_events.date_policy: Assigned Monday; same morning post stated, separate shipments. Keep earlier Fitch lots distinct.

evidence.quote: by the same morning Post two new species from Mr Morris arrived

objects: Missing Sowerby reply and one completed plate
receipt_events.date_policy: By letter date, same post but no independent exact arrival day.

evidence.quote: By the same Post, there came in answer to my letter of complaint to Mr Sowerby one of 5 Plates perfect

reference_observations.description: Intermediate associated valves support lumping maximum/sulcatum at this stage; preserve tentative earlier names and later changes without harmonizing them.

evidence.quote: P. maximus & sulcatus of Sowerby are only varieties
there is always a risk in describing separate valves of making several nominal species out of one

reference_observations.description: Earlier carina permission was granted and work completed; permission for newly discussed upside-down valve remains requested. No incoming permission text survives.

evidence.quote: I have well exhibited the additional side to the carina, which you granted me permission to do
But do not say yes, without you would like it

reference_observations.description: Ready for press remains an intention while drawings are delayed; subsequent 1851 press start cannot be assigned to April 1850.
Sowerby demolition explanation arrives now; earlier speculation in 1366 should not be rewritten as this confirmed reported cause.

evidence.quote: one chief cause of the delay has been that his house has been pulled down in the Botanic Gardens
